name: Cable Single-Arm Triceps Pushdown
steps: Stand facing a high pulley with one hand on the handle and your elbow bent at your side.
Press the handle down until your working arm straightens beside your thigh.
Bend your elbow to return the handle to waist level.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your shoulder above your hip throughout the press.
Pin your working elbow beside your ribs instead of letting it drift forward.
